integrity: Exact finite data are reproduced by the included dependency-free Python checker. The proof explicitly separates exact arithmetic certificates from the rooted-forest and chromatic partition arguments. Originality has literature-search limitations, and there is no independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Specific pair of eleven-vertex complements of trees; no global minimality result and no assertion of homotopy inequivalence. Equality concerns the full Morse-ensemble polynomial; the chromatic number itself is equal, while six-coloring counts and chromatic polynomials differ.
title: Two collapsible independence complexes with identical Morse ensembles and different chromatic polynomials
